items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC-1..AC-13 each have code and a proving test; spec-reviewer PASS; no feature beyond the seven cards (override_marker.py is an extraction to hold the 300-line cap).

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Every OSError on the override path blocks (marker unreadable now counts as used, doubt fix); the parser over-fires on RecursionError, depth cap and unparseable text.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Command text is only lexed, never executed; no secrets; the override gate fails closed, and a restored log cannot revive a used override (untracked marker).

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Tests assert exact commit tuples, release outcomes and WARN text on real strings, temp dirs and git repos; each review regression is pinned by a test.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Fallback regex made atomic (no catastrophic backtracking, pinned by a timing test); lock waits are bounded by LOCK_WAIT_S with 50 ms sleeps.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New modules follow the lib/ stdlib-only pattern; compliance_override.py is 287 lines and new test files stay under 300 (bloat gate).

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Hook payload cwd, bash command text and the override log/marker files are the boundaries; the log-restore round trip and the cwd-to-project resolution are exercised by tests.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: No skips added; the git-dependent cases use the repo's existing needs_git marker; one pytest root (plugins/shipwright-compliance/tests) per process.
